lead_fa: بازی Arms Warrior پرتنش است: خونریزی، پروک و اکسکیوت. روتیشن با ترکیب [[Mortal Strike]] و [[Overpower]] و [[Rend]] می‌چرخد، با [[Colossus Smash]] منفجر می‌شود و با [[Execute]]های سنگین تمام می‌کند؛ [[Rage]] سریع پر و خالی می‌شود و هنر تو خرج‌کردن درست آن است. دو مسیر Hero Tree داری: [[Slayer]] که [[Execute]] و [[Bladestorm]] را پرتکرارتر و قوی‌تر می‌کند و برچسب Best منبع را دارد، و [[Colossus]] با کانال [[Demolish]] و تقویت [[Cleave]] و [[Mortal Strike]].

strengths: Execute damage niche and strong two-target cleave
Strong burst mobility and gap closers
Good personal defensive abilities and a raid-wide defensive cooldown
weaknesses: Reliant on the Shaman Skyfury buff to maximize resource generation
Very specialized builds focusing on single-target or multi-target damage, rarely both at once
Very susceptible to downtime due to no ranged abilities or passive resource generation
Minimum range restrictions and cooldowns can limit mobility

buffs: Mortal Strike no longer reduces the cooldown of Demolish
Slayer gains significantly more Sudden Death procs in 12.1
nerfs: Removed abilities: Skullsplitter, Bitter Immunity and Thunderous Roar
Warbreaker removed and baked into Colossus Smash
changes_12_1.note: Arms underwent several major talent changes in Midnight, including the removal of some active abilities.

hero.recommendation: Slayer carries the Best tags for Single Target, Raid Multitarget and Mythic+ Dungeons; Colossus is the alternative without Best tags. Colossus greatly enhances Cleave and Mortal Strike and adds the channeled Demolish on a short cooldown, plus an automatic heal when near death. Slayer does not add anything new to the toolkit but greatly enhances Execute and Bladestorm, making both more frequent and significantly more damaging, with bonuses to Charge and Heroic Leap and the ability to interrupt and stun while channeling Bladestorm; it lacks compelling defensive benefits.
hero.slayer: Greatly enhances Execute and Bladestorm, causing both to be used much more frequently and deal significantly increased damage; bonuses to Charge and Heroic Leap and the long-desired ability to interrupt and stun while channeling Bladestorm.
hero.colossus: Greatly enhances Cleave and Mortal Strike while gaining Demolish, a powerful channeled cast that deals substantial damage on a short cooldown; Colossus warriors are slightly larger and have an automatic heal when near death.

concepts: Avoid downtime: Rage comes mostly from auto-attacks, so minimize time spent chasing targets or running mechanics; use Charge and Heroic Leap smartly
Keep abilities on cooldown: aligning the various 15, 30, 45 or 90-second cooldowns (Colossus Smash, Avatar, Bladestorm/Demolish) is crucial; delaying one desyncs the others
Avoid wasting Rage: Rage starts from zero and decays out of combat; spend efficiently to keep the rotation flowing
A priority list read top to bottom after every cast; the rotation revolves around rage management, bleeds and maximizing Execute damage
st_priority: Cast Cleave to apply or refresh Rend when less than 10 seconds remain and Colossus Smash is off cooldown
Cast Execute with two stacks of Sudden Death
Cast Execute immediately before Bladestorm if you have less than 3 stacks of Imminent Demise
Cast Cleave to refresh Rend with less than 5 seconds remaining
Cast Slam when nothing else is available
execute_priority: Cast Avatar shortly before or with Colossus Smash
Cast Mortal Strike with two stacks of Executioner's Precision
Cast Execute during Sudden Death or with more than 40 rage
aoe_priority: Cast Ravager just before Colossus Smash
Cast Avatar just before or with Colossus Smash
Cast Mortal Strike with less than 10 stacks of Colossal Might
Cast Slam if nothing else is available
rotation.aoe_note: Sweeping Strikes lets Arms cleave its normal single-target rotation onto a secondary target, while true multi-target rotations invest heavily into Cleave.

cooldowns.Colossus Smash: Arms' primary cooldown, used liberally on single or multiple targets; its cooldown is reduced by Anger Management which should keep it aligned with Avatar most of the time; keeping it active as much as possible is the most important part of maximizing Arms damage
cooldowns.Avatar: Major burst cooldown aligned with Colossus Smash
cooldowns.Bladestorm: Slayer channels it during Colossus Smash and can interrupt and stun while channeling
cooldowns.Champion's Spear: Major listed cooldown in the rotation
cooldowns.Demolish: Colossus' channeled cast dealing substantial damage on a short cooldown; the very first Demolish may be delayed to build a bigger buff

rotation.hero_notes: Slayer does not use Crushing Combo, so Cleave is not spammed regularly; with Crushing Combo (Colossus) Cleave is spammed repeatedly after Colossus Smash. Storm Bolt is an extremely minor damage increase during Bladestorm and not worth a talent. Execute timing varies with Sudden Death procs and does not need to be spent immediately with only one charge.
opener: Always open with Charge for a small rage boost; otherwise the opener is virtually identical to the single-target priority
pre_combat: Ensure Battle Shout is active on yourself and all relevant party members before any form of combat

gear.gearing_rules: Both Colossus and Slayer emphasize weapon damage and Strength (via item level) along with Critical Strike and Haste; secondary stat values fluctuate since heavily stacked stats lose value past diminishing returns. Critical Strike and Haste have a complicated relationship: both increase rage generation while Haste also speeds the GCD to spend rage inside Colossus Smash windows; they frequently flip position, so generally want both. Sim with Raidbots.

mplus.hero_note: Slayer carries the Best tag for Mythic+ Dungeons this season: more Sudden Death procs in 12.1 feed frequent Executes while Bladestorm channels through Colossus Smash windows. Arms builds are very specialized between single and multi-target, rarely both at once.
tips: Keep Sweeping Strikes rolling so your single-target rotation cleaves onto a secondary target
Invest into Cleave for true multi-target moments and refresh Rend early on packs
Align Ravager, Avatar and Colossus Smash: delaying one desyncs the rest
Charge and Heroic Leap are your downtime killers; never walk when you can leap
Skyfury from a shaman matters for rage generation; plan around having it
